parameters.name: FailureReasons
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the failure conditions that have occurred during the accumulation period. {{enum}} Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|section 11.4.3}} ''Current Group Failure Reason''.

parameters.name: UpstreamRate
parameters.description: The achieved upstream data rate in {{units}} (which might change subject to dynamic link usage conditions). Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|section 11.4.2}} ''Achieved Aggregate Data Rate''.

parameters.name: DownstreamRate
parameters.description: The achieved downstream data rate in {{units}} (which might change subject to dynamic link usage conditions). Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|section 11.4.2}} ''Achieved Aggregate Data Rate''.

parameters.name: UpstreamPacketLoss
parameters.description: The total number of upstream packets that were lost at aggregation output from a bonding group during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|section 11.4.2}} ''Group Rx Cell Loss Count''.

parameters.name: DownstreamPacketLoss
parameters.description: The total number of downstream packets that were lost at aggregation output from a bonding group during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|section 11.4.2}} ''Group Rx Cell Loss Count''.

parameters.name: UpstreamDifferentialDelay
parameters.description: The achieved upstream differential delay in {{units}} (which might change subject to dynamic link usage conditions).

parameters.name: DownstreamDifferentialDelay
parameters.description: The achieved downstream differential delay in {{units}} (which might change subject to dynamic link usage conditions).

parameters.name: FailureCount
parameters.description: The number of times that the group was declared ''Unavailable'' during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|G.998.1|Section 11.4.3}} ''Group Failure Count''.

parameters.name: ErroredSeconds
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} during which the group was declared ''Errored'' during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|TR-159}} ''oBondingGroup.aGroupPerf**ES''.

parameters.name: SeverelyErroredSeconds
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} during which the group was declared ''SeverelyErrored'' during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|TR-159}} ''oBondingGroup.aGroupPerf**SES''.

parameters.name: UnavailableSeconds
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} during which the group was declared ''Unavailable'' during the accumulation period. Corresponds to {{bibref|TR-159}} ''oBondingGroup.aGroupPerf**UAS''.

object.description: Total statistics for this bonding group. Note: The {{object}} parameters SHOULD NOT be reset when the interface statistics are reset via an interface disable / enable cycle.
